items.title: Dave Bailey and John McNeil Interview, 1959-10-25
items.q: I know the last time he was at the hospital to come see somebody there, he had a cab line running.

ctx.x: Is he related to Millie and those guys or did he?

I don't know if he's related to Millie. Millie used to play with us too, man, the young tuxedo. Millie Bond, a chronic player. Sure. Millie used to like to play with me. I was playing with the old brother. What instrument did he play? The Siddly Days' meeting, trumpet. Bright brother, he looked like a white man. He was sitting at the band. Yeah. Then he met bands. So I don't know if he's playing anymore now. I know the last time he was at the hospital to come see somebody there, he had a cab line running. He was…
A fella, Joe Phillips, plays trumpet. He was taking Sidney's band. They were pretty good. Yeah. Yeah, Sidney. Sidney, I think. Joe Phillips is a good trumpet man too. You don't know him.
